strings.name: Kumar Mangalam Birla
strings.role: Chairman of the Aditya Birla Group
strings.summary: Kumar Mangalam Birla is an Indian businessman who has led the Aditya Birla Group since 1995, with interests in metals, cement, textiles and financial services. A chartered accountant with business school training, he has participated in international acquisitions and higher education governance. He received the Padma Bhushan in 2023.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Group and personal actions, chairmanship and executive management, current and former educational roles, and investment intentions and completed transactions are distinguished.
strings.influence.rationale: Leads the Aditya Birla Group, expanding its metals, cement, textiles and financial services businesses.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education and qualifications
strings.facts.f1.value: A qualified chartered accountant; London Business School identifies him as an MBA alumnus of the class of 1992.
strings.facts.f2.label: Higher education governance
strings.facts.f2.value: Current chancellor of BITS Pilani; chaired IIM Ahmedabad’s Board of Governors from October 21, 2016 to November 15, 2022.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Group businesses and international acquisitions
strings.highlights.h1.text: Leads a diversified group; Hindalco completed its acquisition of Novelis in 2007. This was a corporate transaction, not a personal purchase.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Corporate and educational governance
strings.highlights.h2.text: Holds governance responsibilities on corporate boards and at educational institutions; being a non-executive chairman does not mean being CEO.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Discussed investment intentions in Uttar Pradesh
strings.timeline.t1.text: Told reporters during IIT BHU’s convocation that further investment was planned, without disclosing an amount or timetable.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Became Vodafone Idea’s non-executive chairman
strings.timeline.t2.text: The company confirmed his appointment from his existing non-executive director position; it did not appoint him CEO.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Received the Padma Bhushan
strings.timeline.t3.text: The President of India conferred the award for contributions to trade and industry.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Ended his IIM Ahmedabad chairmanship
strings.timeline.t4.text: The institution’s archive gives this date as the end of his Board of Governors term.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Became IIM Ahmedabad chairman
strings.timeline.t5.text: Began chairing the institution’s Board of Governors, a governance role.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Hindalco completed the Novelis acquisition
strings.timeline.t6.text: The agreement signed in February closed, making Novelis a Hindalco subsidiary.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Took charge of the Aditya Birla Group
strings.timeline.t7.text: Became group chairman, subsequently advancing diversification and international expansion.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completed his London Business School MBA
strings.timeline.t8.text: The school’s scholarship page explicitly identifies his MBA class as 1992.
